picks.name: Citizen Boy
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Sirens" (August 27, 2026) explores the minimal, hardcore side of gqom -- stripped back, fewer melodies, focused on raw sounds, heavy rhythms and pure energy across four tracks: Sirens, Demolition, Blue Sea, Sirens 2.0.
picks.why_listen: A darker, more relentless take on gqom from an artist you already play -- good for a stripped-back, drum-forward stretch of a set.

picks.name: DJ.MC
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Moveltraxx. Similar Chicago footwork/juke territory to your DJ Manny and Kush Jones picks.
picks.bio: Chicago South Side footwork mainstay, making music since 2001. "[MTXLT902] STFU & Footwork" (August 14, 2026) is a five-track EP for Moveltraxx's Footwork Appreciation Month -- experimental yet dancefloor-ready, built from his own voice, soulful samples and hypnotic drum programming.
picks.why_listen: Raw, low-end Chicago footwork from a scene veteran -- solid source for high-tempo transitions with real grit.
